description:
Compare two crawl_site runs of a site: the Site Health and theme score changes, and per check how many issues are new and how many were fixed, plus pages added, removed or changed status, and robots.txt rule changes.

Billing: free — compares stored crawls; nothing is fetched.

Defaults to the site's latest scored crawl against the one before it (the previous scored crawl graded with the same check version, preferring one crawled with the same settings scope; a different scope gives scope_changed: true and no pages added/removed). Pass run_id and base_run_id (from history[].run_id) for any two. Crawls graded with different check versions compare totals only (mode "summary": new/fixed and the health delta are null). Crawls made before Site Audit checks can't be compared.

Inputs:
  site_id     — the AuditAE site id (from list_sites).
  run_id      — optional run to read; default the latest scored crawl.
  base_run_id — optional earlier run to compare it with; default the crawl before it.

Returns: { site_id, run: { run_id, started_at, site_health }, base: { run_id, started_at, site_health } | null, comparison: { mode, health: { from, to, delta }, counts, themes: { <id>: { from, to, delta } }, totals: { new_errors, fixed_errors, new_items, fixed_items }, checks: [{ id, severity, from, to, new, fixed, removed, new_s, fixed_s }] (changed only, biggest change first), pages: { added, removed, status_changed, became_broken, became_noindex, became_indexable, title_changed, samples } | null, robots: { changed, added_rules, removed_rules }, sitemap } | null, history: [{ run_id, started_at, site_health, health_delta, errors, warnings }] (≤12), note?, suggested_next?, next_step }. new/fixed count pages for page checks. For the URLs behind a check's change, get_crawl_issue with compare "new" or "fixed". base null: the first scored crawl.

base_run_id.description: Optional run to compare with. Default: the crawl before run_id.

run_id.description: Optional run id (history[].run_id). Default: the latest scored crawl.

name: compare_crawls
title: Compare two crawls of a site: new and fixed issues, Site Health change
